behavior: `Select` keeps its popup element and its items in the DOM, hidden and inert, from the first focus of its trigger, its first open or the first fill of its input. A reference to the popup or to an item stays valid after each close. Base UI keeps them only when the trigger got the focus, or the browser autofilled the hidden input, before the end of the close. A select that opens with `defaultOpen`, with the `open` prop, or with a press that does not focus the trigger removes its popup at the end of the close. When the focus then returns to the trigger, Base UI mounts a new popup one task later. When the focus goes to another element, the closed select has no items until its trigger gets the focus.
